BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllJob - Class in edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.jobs
Parses a pasted ACM DL "Cited By > View All" page and adds each citing paper as a new BibTeX entry citing the current one, via BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllService.
BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllJob() - Constructor for class edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.jobs.BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllJob
 
BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllService - Class in edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services
Parses the text ACM Digital Library's "Cited By > View All" page produces (an alternating sequence of one or more ACM-Ref-formatted citation lines, then the citing paper's https://doi.org/... link, repeated for each citing paper) and, for each DOI that passes a sanity check, resolves full metadata and adds a new BibTexEntry recording it as citing the current paper — so a user can paste ACM DL's whole "cited by" list at once instead of adding each citing paper one at a time.
BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllService(BibTexEntryRepository, CitationGraphService, DOIService) - Constructor for class edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllService
 
BulkReferenceUploadFromACMDLJob - Class in edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.jobs
Parses a pasted ACM DL References section and adds each reference as a new BibTeX entry cited by the current one, via BulkReferenceUploadFromACMDLService.
BulkReferenceUploadFromACMDLJob() - Constructor for class edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.jobs.BulkReferenceUploadFromACMDLJob
 
BulkReferenceUploadFromACMDLService - Class in edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services
Parses the HTML of an ACM Digital Library paper's References section (specifically, the inner HTML of the node containing <section id="bibliography">) and, for each entry a DOI can be extracted from, resolves full metadata and adds a new BibTexEntry recording the current paper as citing it — so a user can paste a paper's whole References list at once instead of adding each reference one at a time.

CitationGraphService - Class in edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services
Orchestrates the "Get References" and "Get Citations" jobs: looks up a source BibTexEntry's DOI across a chain of CitationMetadataResolvers (OpenAlex first, then Semantic Scholar, then Crossref), resolves the related works the first successful resolver names, synthesizes+saves a BibTexEntry for each one not already present (deduped by DOI), and records a CitationEdge between the source and each related entry.

CitationGraphService.ExistingEntries - Record Class in edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services
A project's existing entries, indexed for fast dedup lookups during resolve-or-create: byDoi to detect an entry that already represents a given DOI, citeKeys to keep newly generated citeKeys from colliding with ones already in use.

ResolvedWork - Record Class in edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services
A minimal, resolver-agnostic projection of a scholarly work, carrying only the fields BibTexSynthesisService needs to synthesize a BibTeX entry, plus enough of its reference/citation graph for CitationGraphService to discover related works without a second round-trip where a resolver's API already hands them over in the same response.

updateAbstract(String, Long, String) - Method in class edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.controller.BibTexEntriesController
Updates just the abstract field of a BibTeX entry, leaving every other field untouched — a narrower alternative to BibTexEntriesController.updateBibTexEntry(java.lang.String, java.lang.Long, java.lang.String) for BibTexEntryShowPage's Abstract card, useful when the abstract comes from a different source than the rest of the entry (see issue #79).
updateBibTexEntry(String, Long, String) - Method in class edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.controller.BibTexEntriesController
